raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--speculative-accept-threshold-acc` raises a draft token's target probability from `p` to `min(1, p / threshold_acc)` so the draft is easier to accept. DSpark rejection sampling hardcoded the value to `1.0`, and the shared Triton chain kernel never passed it in, so the flag and `POST /set_internal_state` did not change acceptance.

## Modifications

- Scale the target probability inside chain rejection sampling, for both the sequential accept test (`coin * q < min(1, p / threshold_acc)`) and block verification's prefix probability. `threshold_acc=1` keeps the previous test for probabilities (`p <= 1`). Values below `1e-9` are clamped.
- DSpark reads the live spec config on every verify step, so a `/set_internal_state` update applies without a restart.
- EAGLE rejection-sampling startup still rejects a non-default threshold. The shared kernel is what EAGLE rejection sampling calls; the launch check is unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Measured with the same accept rule on GSM8K (1319 questions, temperature=0.9) on 2026-10-25. Not re-run on this commit.

| threshold_acc | accuracy | accept length |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.0 | 0.9227 | 3.619 |
| 0.95 | 0.9189 | 3.546 |

At 0.95, accept length did not increase and accuracy dropped slightly.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No separate speed benchmark. The change is only in the accept comparison.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+def _speculative_accept_threshold_acc() -> float:
+    """Live ``--speculative-accept-threshold-acc`` for DSpark rejection sampling.
+
+    ``/set_internal_state`` writes the field onto the spec config bag, so the
+    next verify step sees it without a restart. Values below 1e-9 are clamped
+    so the kernel never divides by zero. 1.0 keeps the unscaled accept test.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_spec
+
+    return max(float(get_spec().speculative_accept_threshold_acc), 1e-9)
+

     )

@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+"""DSpark rejection sampling must honor speculative_accept_threshold_acc.
+
+The value is read from the live spec config on every verify step, including
+updates from /set_internal_state, and forwarded into chain rejection sampling.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.dspark import dspark_accept
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, reset_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDsparkAcceptThresholdAcc(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        reset_context()
+        get_context().set_server_args(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        reset_context()
+
+    def _forwarded_threshold(self) -> float:
+        bs, slots, vocab = 2, 3, 8
+        captured = {}
+
+        def _fake_kernel(**kwargs):
+            captured.update(kwargs)
+
+        sampling_info = SimpleNamespace(
+            need_top_k_sampling=False,
+            need_top_p_sampling=False,
+            temperatures=torch.ones(bs, dtype=torch.float32),
+        )
+        original = dspark_accept.chain_speculative_sampling_triton
+        dspark_accept.chain_speculative_sampling_triton = _fake_kernel
+        try:
+            dspark_accept._accept_sampling_core(
+                candidates=torch.zeros(bs, slots, dtype=torch.int64),
+                target_logits=torch.zeros(bs * slots, vocab),
+                draft_probs=torch.zeros(bs, slots, vocab),
+                sampling_info=sampling_info,
+                draft_input=None,
+                gamma=slots - 1,
+                verify_num_draft_tokens=slots,
+                cutoff_verify_lens=None,
+                block_verification=False,
+            )
+        finally:
+            dspark_accept.chain_speculative_sampling_triton = original
+        return captured["threshold_acc"]
+
+    def test_default_threshold_is_one(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._forwarded_threshold(), 1.0)
+
+    def test_runtime_override_is_forwarded(self):
+        get_context().override(
+            "update_server_args", speculative_accept_threshold_acc=0.95
+        )
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(self._forwarded_threshold(), 0.95)
+
+    def test_nonpositive_threshold_is_clamped(self):
+        get_context().override(
+            "update_server_args", speculative_accept_threshold_acc=0.0
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self._forwarded_threshold(), 1e-9)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
